description: Recto: Yehuday Gaʾon, Halaḵot Pesuqot, Hilḵot ʿEruvin. Verso: note of purchase stating that ʿAmram ha-Kohen b. Aharon ha-Kohen b. ʿAmram bought ‘Halaḵot of Yehudai Gaʾon’ from Shemuʾel ha-Kohen b. Natan ha-Kohen. The former name is surrounded with small letters, only some of which are preserved. (Information mainly from CUDL and PGP signatures database.)
